🆕 Newly posted (Published: August 24, 2026)

We are recruiting participating companies for the "Reiwa 8 (2026) Tokorozawa and Hanno District Job Interview Fair for New High School Graduates and Others," to be held on Monday, October 19, 2026 (Reiwa 8).

To apply, please submit your application via the participation application form by Tuesday, September 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8). An email address is required to use the form. If you do not have email access, download the application form from the Hello Work Hanno website and mail it to arrive by Tuesday, September 1, 2026 (Reiwa 8).

Please check the participation application form for details on participation conditions and other requirements.

Inquiries: Tokorozawa Public Employment Security Office, School Graduates Division (1st and 2nd floors, Tokorozawa Joint Government Building, 6-1-3 Namiki, Tokorozawa City) Phone: 04-2992-8609 (Department code 33#)

Source (Japanese): https://www.city.hanno.lg.jp/soshikikarasagasu/kankyokeizaibu/sangyoshinkoka/14284.html
